theory Monads

Computational monads

State and exception monads in type theory, Kleisli arrows, and algebraic effect laws.

State and Exception monads and algebraic effect laws in CTT.

This theory formalizes: 1. The State monad `State(S; A) == S → A × S`, Return, Bind, and Kleisli composition. 2. State inspection and mutation primitives (`Get`, `Put`, `EvalState`, `ExecState`). 3. Algebraic State laws: Left Unit, Put-Get, Put-Put, Get-Put, and Get-Get idempotence. 4. The Exception / Error monad `Except(E; A) == E ⊎ A`, Return, Throw, Bind, and Catch. 5. Exception laws: Left Unit, short-circuiting on Throw, and Catch resolution.

17 theorems, 16 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

-- | State and Exception monads and algebraic effect laws in CTT.
--
-- This theory formalizes:
-- 1. The State monad `State(S; A) == S → A × S`, Return, Bind, and Kleisli composition.
-- 2. State inspection and mutation primitives (`Get`, `Put`, `EvalState`, `ExecState`).
-- 3. Algebraic State laws: Left Unit, Put-Get, Put-Put, Get-Put, and Get-Get idempotence.
-- 4. The Exception / Error monad `Except(E; A) == E ⊎ A`, Return, Throw, Bind, and Catch.
-- 5. Exception laws: Left Unit, short-circuiting on Throw, and Catch resolution.
theory Monads

comment book "State and Exception monads, algebraic laws, and state interaction equations."

abs Fst(p) == let <u, v> = p in u
abs Snd(p) == let <u, v> = p in v

-- State monad:
abs State(S; A) == S → A × S
abs SReturn(x) == λs. <x, s>
abs SBind(m; f) == λs. let <a, s1> = m s in f a s1
abs SKleisli(f; g) == λx. SBind(f x; g)

abs Get == λs. <s, s>
abs Put(s1) == λs. <Ax, s1>

abs RunState(m; s) == m s
abs EvalState(m; s) == Fst(m s)
abs ExecState(m; s) == Snd(m s)

-- Exception monad:
abs Except(E; A) == E ⊎ A
abs EReturn(x) == inr x
abs EThrow(e) == inl e
abs EBind(m; f) ==
  decide m of
    inl err => inl err
  | inr val => f val
abs ECatch(m; h) ==
  decide m of
    inl err => h err
  | inr val => inr val

soft Fst, Snd
soft State, SReturn, SBind, SKleisli, Get, Put, RunState, EvalState, ExecState
soft Except, EReturn, EThrow, EBind, ECatch

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- State monad: typing
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem sreturn_ty :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. A → State(S; A)
proof
  intro S
  intro A
  intro x
  intro s
  auto
qed

theorem get_ty :
  ∀S:U{i}. State(S; S)
proof
  intro S
  intro s
  auto
qed

theorem put_ty :
  ∀S:U{i}. S → State(S; Unit)
proof
  intro S
  intro s1
  intro s
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- State monad: algebraic laws
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Left identity: Bind (Return x) f = f x
theorem state_left_unit :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}.
  ∀x:A. ∀f:(A → State(S; B)). ∀s:S.
    SBind(SReturn(x); f) s = f x s ∈ B × S
proof
  intro S
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro f
  intro s
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem state_eval_return :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀s:S.
    EvalState(SReturn(x); s) = x ∈ A
proof
  intro S
  intro A
  intro x
  intro s
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem state_exec_return :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀s:S.
    ExecState(SReturn(x); s) = s ∈ S
proof
  intro S
  intro A
  intro x
  intro s
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- State interaction equations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Put followed by Get returns the written state:
theorem state_put_get :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀s1:S. ∀s:S.
    SBind(Put(s1); (λu. Get)) s = <s1, s1> ∈ S × S
proof
  intro S
  intro s1
  intro s
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

-- Put followed by Put overwrites:
theorem state_put_put :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀s1:S. ∀s2:S. ∀s:S.
    SBind(Put(s1); (λu. Put(s2))) s = <Ax, s2> ∈ Unit × S
proof
  intro S
  intro s1
  intro s2
  intro s
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

-- Get followed by Put of the same state is a no-op on the store:
theorem state_get_put :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀s:S.
    SBind(Get; (λs1. Put(s1))) s = <Ax, s> ∈ Unit × S
proof
  intro S
  intro s
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

-- Get followed by Get yields identical values (idempotence):
theorem state_get_get :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. ∀k:(S → S → State(S; A)). ∀s:S.
    SBind(Get; (λs1. SBind(Get; (λs2. k s1 s2)))) s =
      SBind(Get; (λs1. k s1 s1)) s ∈ A × S
proof
  intro S
  intro A
  intro k
  intro s
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

-- Associativity step on a computed return:
theorem state_assoc_step :
  ∀S:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}.
  ∀a:A. ∀s:S. ∀f:(A → State(S; B)). ∀g:(B → State(S; C)).
    SBind(SBind(SReturn(a); f); g) s =
      SBind(SReturn(a); (λx. SBind(f x; g))) s ∈ C × S
proof
  intro S
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro a
  intro s
  intro f
  intro g
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exception monad: typing and laws
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem except_return_ty :
  ∀E:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. A → Except(E; A)
proof
  intro E
  intro A
  intro x
  intro right
  hyp
qed

theorem except_throw_ty :
  ∀E:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. E → Except(E; A)
proof
  intro E
  intro A
  intro err
  intro left
  hyp
qed

theorem except_left_unit :
  ∀E:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}.
  ∀x:A. ∀f:(A → Except(E; B)).
    EBind(EReturn(x); f) = f x ∈ Except(E; B)
proof
  intro E
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro f
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem except_bind_throw :
  ∀E:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}.
  ∀err:E. ∀f:(A → Except(E; B)).
    EBind(EThrow(err); f) = EThrow(err) ∈ Except(E; B)
proof
  intro E
  intro A
  intro B
  intro err
  intro f
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem except_catch_throw :
  ∀E:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}.
  ∀err:E. ∀h:(E → Except(E; A)).
    ECatch(EThrow(err); h) = h err ∈ Except(E; A)
proof
  intro E
  intro A
  intro err
  intro h
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem except_catch_return :
  ∀E:U{i}. ∀A:U{i}.
  ∀x:A. ∀h:(E → Except(E; A)).
    ECatch(EReturn(x); h) = EReturn(x) ∈ Except(E; A)
proof
  intro E
  intro A
  intro x
  intro h
  reduce
  eq THEN auto
qed
